paragraphs: QuickScores sells league and tournament scheduling, online registration, and roster management for sports programs. The homepage presents the product as a way to make managing a sports program as easy as possible. Coaches, players, parents, and officials are named alongside the league administrators as people the site serves.

The homepage states that QuickScores provides scheduling for over 750 sports organizations. Testimonials on that page are signed by park districts, including Glen Ellyn Park District. The pages say support does not run through an automated voice system. Personal phone numbers are given out so clients can get help quickly. An API is offered for retrieving an organization's public data and displaying it on another website or app.

quote.text: QuickScores is dedicated to making it as easy as possible to manage your sports program.
